market.question: Will the highest temperature in Sao Paulo be 28°C on May 1?

assessment.reasoning: Sao Paulo Guarulhos May 1 climatological high averages ~23°C, peak May daily high in climate data is ~23.6°C. The market resolves to the single-degree bucket containing the high — needing exactly 28°C, well above climatology. Probability is low (~5-12%).
data_sources: whereandwhen.net Sao Paulo May avg high ~23°C
assessment.key_uncertainty: An unusual late-summer pulse before the cooler Brazilian autumn deepens could push the high higher than climatology.
